config.criteria: Keep only papers whose main contribution is a general framework, benchmark, dataset or metric for EVALUATING RAG systems, usable across domains. Score 0 for any paper tied to one application domain or one language group (for example medicine, law, telecom, security, agriculture, soil science, a specific language), even if the title contains the word evaluation. Score 0 for papers that mainly propose a new RAG method, surveys, tutorials, and product documentation.
